data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"The single-evaluation signature that distinguishes genuine reliability from mere compliance is inter-member error decorrelation on cases the checklist does not cover: if panel members disagree with each other and produce dispersed errors on uncovered cases, they are reasoning independently; if they agree with each other and fail identically on uncovered cases, they are merely complying with a shared rule and the reliability gain is compliance-tracking, not genuine.","counterconditions":[{"case":"If the checklist covers the entire test distribution, there are no 'uncovered cases' and the diagnostic cannot be computed within the evaluation.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If panel members reason independently but share the same background misconception, they will produce correlated errors on uncovered cases without it being mere compliance, confounding the diagnostic.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the single expert also fails identically on uncovered cases, the panel's correlated failure is indistinguishable from expert failure and the comparison provides no relative discrimination.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the definition of 'covered' versus 'uncovered' is itself ambiguous or post hoc, the classification can be gamed to manufacture the appearance of decorrelation.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"Decompose the test set into cases the checklist explicitly addresses and cases it does not. On covered cases, both genuine reasoning and mere compliance produce high accuracy. On uncovered cases, genuine reasoning manifests as independent judgment: members disagree, errors are dispersed, and aggregation may still recover the right answer through diversity. Mere compliance manifests as correlated failure: members apply the nearest checklist rule, make the same error, and aggregation cannot help because the errors are perfectly correlated. The diagnostic is the intra-panel error correlation coefficient on uncovered cases, not overall accuracy.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
